description: Edit one or more images using Google Gemini image models (Nano Banana Pro). Provide images and natural-language instructions for how to modify them. Returns edited image with inline preview and saves full-resolution to disk.

global_media_resolution.description: Global image quality setting (default: HIGH). See generate_image for details.

images.description: One or more images to edit

filePath.description: Local file path to the image (alternative to base64 data). The image is loaded server-side, bypassing MCP transport limits. Use the filePath returned by load_image_from_path.

mediaResolution.description: Per-image resolution override. LOW=280 tokens (75% savings), MEDIUM=560 tokens (50% savings), HIGH=1120 tokens (default), ULTRA_HIGH=2000+ tokens (max detail, per-image only)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image (e.g., image/png, image/jpeg). Required when using data, auto-detected from filePath.

thoughtSignature.description: Thought signature from a previous generate_image or edit_image call. Required for conversational editing with Gemini 3 Pro Image. Pass the thoughtSignature from the previous response to maintain edit context.

model.description: Gemini image model to use (default: gemini-3-pro-image, Nano Banana Pro). Also: gemini-3.1-flash-image (Nano Banana 2)

outputPath.description: Optional file path to save the edited image (e.g., ./output/edited.png)

prompt.description: Instructions for how to edit the image(s)

use_search.description: Enable Google Search grounding for data-driven editing

name: edit_image
title: Edit Image with Gemini
